models.name: Gemma 4 E2B (instruct)
models.description: Google's edge multimodal model: text + image. ~2B effective parameters, good balance of accuracy and CPU speed. Default.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B (instruct)
models.description: Larger Gemma 4 edge model: better accuracy, roughly twice the compute of E2B.

models.name: Qwen3.5 2B
models.description: Alibaba's natively multimodal 2B model. Strong vision; image support in llama.cpp, no video.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.description: Larger Qwen3.5; better accuracy at roughly twice the compute of 2B.

models.name: Qwen3-VL 2B (instruct)
models.description: Qwen3 vision-language 2B. Very good at describing images; a solid alternative to Gemma for image verdicts.

models.name: SmolVLM 500M (instruct)
models.description: Tiny vision model for very low-end hardware. Fast but noticeably less accurate; text verdicts are weak.

models.name: Moondream2
models.description: Compact ~2B vision model. Good image understanding; text classification quality is limited.

models.name: Phi-4 mini (instruct, text only)
models.description: Microsoft's 3.8B text model. No vision: image verdicts are unavailable with this model.
